title: Far-From-Threshold Buckling of Indented Spherical Shells
exact_target: Describe the deeply buckled or crumpled shapes of pressureless indented shells and how their localized deformation evolves.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30003737 (OWR-15993-005). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.

status_qualification: The shell geometry, thickness, boundary loading and substrate limit are model parameters to be specified from the report. A threshold calculation alone does not characterize the requested far-from-threshold pattern.
